details: This package is a dependency-confusion / QA proof-of-concept canary that beacons at install time. A postinstall hook ("node./index.cjs") sends an HTTPS POST to hxxps://webhook[.]site/d730a68c-27bd-4bb5-b1b9-d57a0a4b17ac/semz with a JSON body tagged with the literal test_id "UNIQUE-TEST-ID", carrying os.hostname(), os.homedir(), process.platform, and the detected CI provider (github-actions, gitlab-ci, azure-pipelines or jenkins, inferred from the presence of the GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITLAB_CI, TF_BUILD and JENKINS_URL environment variables). The package self-declares as an authorized test artifact and its payload is a single readable 823-byte script containing only host-metadata collection: it reads no credential or token files, no environment values beyond the CI flags above, and exfiltrates no files or secrets. Recorded as security research, not malware.
